title: Determination of Water in Insulating Liquids and in Oil-impregnated Paper and Pressboard by Automatic Coulometric Karl Fischer Titration - Method of Test
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This Standard describes a method for the determination of water in unused or used insulating liquids with coulometrically generated Karl Fischer reagent. The method is applicable to water concentrations above
clause_3_terminology: Determination of Water in Insulating Liquids and in Oil
impregnated Paper and Pressboard by Automatic Coulometric Karl Fischer Titration

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
